images.initial_prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: an additional location key, exactly 1536x1024 landscape PNG at native resolution, full-bleed single image.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED close Han River enclosure key and controls the exact site layout/materials: river at left, huge rectangular concrete bridge pier, black tarps tied to chain-link fence, grey corrugated shipping containers flanking the pier-side yard, compact generator by the left container, thick cables across the ground into the black-violet gate slit with its thin pale cold white-cyan rim on the pier; two small dark-suited tactical guards with torches, no guns. Input image 2 is the APPROVED opposite-bank wide and controls the huge bridge height, orange sodium lamp rhythm and its black-water reflections, distant riverside trees and apartment skyline. Draw the same site from the riverbank park on the enclosure's OWN bank at BLUE HOUR, earlier in the evening than the approved night key.
Establishing oblique view from a low concealed position BEHIND A STACK OF WOODEN PALLETS. Camera about 1.2m above the park path, 20-30m outside the enclosure; a few ordinary stacked timber transport pallets occupy and crop the lower-left foreground and left frame edge, their slats clear in ink, framing the unobstructed middle-distance site beyond. They are the observer's cover; do not add a foreground observer. A riverside park path, strip of grass, low planting and ordinary river railing lead into the composition, with the river continuing on picture-left. On picture-right ahead under the enormous bridge, the same black-tarped fenced enclosure and blank signboard, left generator/container, right container, and broad concrete pier with the little pale-rimmed gate visible through its front fence opening. Preserve this arrangement and the shipping-container / pier / guard scale. A gate only a little taller than a 1.78m adult, containers about 2.6m high, fence about 3m, massive bridge deck around 20m above the yard; crop overhead bridge members at the top rather than compressing the bridge. Exactly TWO tiny guards in the middle distance, normal adult bodies in dark tactical vests over dark suits, each holding a torch down onto the ground, planted on the yard floor. No other people.
Lighting: cool blue-hour sky with a faint last dusk band, legible slate-blue park shadows; the real orange sodium bridge lamps are just coming on and remain the named warm key, catching the concrete and drawing orange streaks on dark blue water. Small secondary container work lights and a tiny gate rim; the gate's near-black violet centre remains darkest. Local crisp wet/gravel highlights like image 1, no whole-image haze, no artificial cyan park glow. Full detail location reference, strong near pallet / middle park and enclosure / far bridge-and-city depth, clean physically connected beams and pier. No text, no pier numbers, no brands, no police tape. Crisp lossless image, no compression blocks or upscaled softness.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

attempts.reason: Foreground pallets rendered with depth-of-field blur; violates required crisp drawn foreground / no DOF.
